item.title: Cloudflare One Client - Cloudflare One Client for macOS (version 2026.9.3000.1)
item.description:
A new beta release is available.

  • Fixed a MASQUE issue where the tunnel could stall while uploading.
  • Fixed a managed registration being removed when the MDM file was missing.
  • Improved the Settings window layout.
  • Fixed a security issue in the local proxy that could expose it to other users. Thanks @someone, see #12.
